Gnosis Interpretation
MOVE below 80 is calm, 80-120 is moderate uncertainty, and 150+ is high stress; 101.30 is moderate. SOFR measures secured overnight funding, not unsecured bank funding. NFCI below zero indicates looser-than-average broad financial conditions; the latest available weekly observation is dated Oct 9, not a live reading.

Fed & Policy Watch
  • Today's verified schedule is housing starts at 8:30 AM ET, NAR Pending Home Sales at 10:00 AM and a $95 billion 6-week Treasury bill auction at 11:30 AM.
  • The Board calendar lists the October 27-28 FOMC meeting on Wednesday, Oct 28 at 2:00 PM ET, followed by the 2:30 PM press conference. This is the principal scheduled policy catalyst in the displayed horizon.
  • Selected Fed statistical releases include H.4.1 Thursday Oct 22 at 4:30 PM, H.8 Friday Oct 23 at 4:15 PM, H.6 Tuesday Oct 27 at 1:00 PM, and the next H.4.1 Thursday Oct 29 at 4:30 PM. Release dates were checked against each row's own Board-listed day list; routine CP and H.15 are omitted.
  • BEA confirms third-quarter GDP (advance estimate) Oct 29 at 8:30 AM ET. The New York Fed calendar also lists Personal Income and the PCE Deflator at that time but gives no period; BEA separately schedules Personal Income and Outlays for October 2026 on Dec 2. These are kept distinct pending clarification.
  • Latest available NFCI is -0.499 for the week ending Oct 9; Chicago Fed's next scheduled NFCI row is Oct 21 for the week ending Oct 16. The release calendar is not an advance observation.
Omissions and Watch
  • Date/event conflict check: the New York Fed October calendar places Employment Situation on Oct 2, CPI on Oct 14, and PPI and Advance Retail Sales on Oct 15. CPI and PPI were checked as separate releases. These are elapsed and excluded; no elapsed event appears in the tables. Within the checked horizon, no CPI, PPI, Employment Situation, Advance Retail Sales, or FOMC minutes release is listed.
  • Board day-list check: H.10 is listed on Oct 19 and Oct 26 (not Oct 20); H.4.1 is listed Oct 22 and Oct 29. H.6 is listed Oct 27 and H.8 Oct 23 and Oct 30. Only future dates are shown.
  • Checked date-specific sources: New York Fed October Economic Indicators Calendar; Federal Reserve Board October calendar and H.4.1 page; Census 2026 calendar; BEA schedule; Chicago Fed release calendar and NFCI data; TreasuryDirect auctions; NAR Pending Home Sales release schedule; Conference Board consumer confidence page; University of Michigan Surveys of Consumers; Philadelphia Fed survey page; EIA petroleum and natural-gas schedules. BLS dates/times are taken from the New York Fed calendar as instructed; the BLS host was not requested.
  • The New York Fed calendar lists the Philadelphia Fed Non-Manufacturing Survey Oct 20 at 8:30 AM; the retrieved Philadelphia Fed page did not independently show a dated October notice, so the calendar row relies on the New York Fed's date-specific listing. Calendar coverage is selected, not exhaustive.
  • EIA's petroleum schedule identifies standard Wednesday timing and a dated Oct 15 Columbus Day exception, but no date-specific Oct 21/28 release entry was verified. The natural-gas schedule gives usual Thursday timing and holiday exceptions but no date-specific Oct 22/29 release entry. No EIA event is projected from weekly cadence.
  • Unscheduled policy or geopolitical risks were not verified in the sources checked; this is not a statement that such risks are absent. WTI's overnight quote is down 4.92% versus the prior completed daily bar; no dated EIA release was verified for today.
  • Market quotes are single-source Yahoo observations. SOFR, NFCI and Treasury yields are dated official publications, not live values. No exchange product-hours verification was performed; confirm contract, hours, liquidity and event updates before execution.
Trading Strategy Note | ES Futures
BASE CASE
Treat the 12:20 AM ET generic ES=F quote as overnight context only. MOVE at 101.30 signals moderate rate uncertainty; latest official 10Y close is 5.15%. Today's housing and NAR releases plus the 11:30 AM Treasury bill auction are scheduled checkpoints; the Oct 28 FOMC meeting is the major upcoming policy event. Use live yields, volatility and liquidity to assess price discovery; scenario framework only, not a directional forecast or trade signal.
INVALIDATION
Reassess if ES sustains a range break without confirmation from live Treasury yields, volatility and market depth, or if the selected contract's hours differ. No unsupported levels or targets are supplied; reconfirm live quotes, event updates and contract details before execution.
